question: How much does changing only the response normalization from stabilized L2 to Q change the saved-grid normalized AUC within each historical saved ranking and policy call?
occurrence_rule: last physical occurrence within canonical source namespace; independently verify conflict-excluded membership
paired_difference: AUC_Q minus AUC_stabilized_L2 on the same saved curve and endpoints
primary: mean across recorded episodes of the within-episode mean paired call difference
primary_rationale: An equally weighted recorded episode is the analysis unit; a longer recorded episode does not receive more primary weight. This is a new paired estimand, distinct from the canonical marginal call medians.
secondary: median of the paired call differences, retaining every defined call; not a difference of marginal medians
undefined_policy: Retain raw membership and reason. If either response endpoint gap is exactly zero, the paired effect is undefined. Nonfinite or malformed input fails authentication. Summaries condition on paired-defined calls, with full raw and defined episode/call counts reported. No clipping or finite replacement.

bootstrap.unit: whole recorded episode within one ranking arm; keep all retained calls together
bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive conditional empirical episode intervals, not independently calibrated coverage
bootstrap.multiplicity: 8 cases and 2 summaries per case; no multiplicity adjustment, no global significance or superiority claim

geometry.actual_endpoint: the stored endpoint, never assumed to be exact self-reference
geometry.residual: r is the implied squared action discrepancy recovered from the native response; retain conversion roundoff diagnostics
geometry.orientation: baseline farther, baseline nearer, or equal; in-range paired ordinate sign depends on orientation
geometry.exact_decomposition: sum trapezoid node-weight contributions to AUC_Q minus AUC_L2 by the exact saved-node categories
geometry.segments: classify sampled endpoint pairs only: both inside, both outside, or one each; do not infer an unobserved continuous crossing
geometry.boundary_sensitivity: repeat labels with tolerance 1e-6 times max(1,abs(r_actual),abs(r_baseline)); values, AUCs and defined-population membership remain unchanged

scope_limits: No cross-ranking-arm pairing, even for matching legacy keys
No new masks, rankings, model calls, GPU work, environment execution or efficacy evidence
Historical nominal percentage grid is retained; realized mask identities/counts are unavailable
Checkpoint, observation, reference action tensor and noise identity remain unauthenticated
Recorded episodes are legacy group labels, not independently authenticated random experimental units
Finite saved-grid interpolation is an analysis convention, not observed intermediate interventions
